data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use Google's ML Kit Image Labeling on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Detects and extracts information about entities in images across a broad group of categories using Google's native ML Kit Image Labeling APIs. Supports base models, local custom TensorFlow Lite models, and Firebase-hosted remote models.
use_when: You need on-device image labeling or object classification in a mobile app
You want to use custom TensorFlow Lite models or Firebase-hosted models for image labeling
avoid_when: You need web or desktop platform support
You require pure Dart or Flutter-only machine learning processing without native platform dependencies
strengths: Leverages optimized native Google ML Kit APIs via platform channels
Supports local custom models and Firebase remote models
weaknesses: Only supports Android and mobile iOS platforms (no web or desktop support)
Requires manual native configuration such as deployment target setup and resource bundles
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum iOS deployment target 15.0, Swift Package Manager setup, linking flags, ML Kit resource bundles, and configuring Android SDK compile and minimum versions.
